classes.name: DataStructure

classes.name: ComplexityClass
classes.subject: computer_science

classes.name: MachineLearningTechnique
classes.subject: computer_science

classes.name: DimensionalityReductionMethod

classes.name: ClusteringAlgorithm
classes.subject: computer_science
classes.description: An algorithm used to group data points into clusters based on similarity, such as k-means clustering or k-mode clustering.

classes.name: NeuralNetwork
classes.subject: computer_science
classes.description: A computational model inspired by the structure and function of biological neural networks, used in machine learning for tasks such as classification and regression.
